notes.title: Narwhar Project Hornwhale going free
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36190395/d0756547b0d7a7e3f91735957e5ea0bad691a2b4.png[/img]
Narwhar Project Hornwhale will be changing soon from paid to [b]free[/b] to play.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36190395/08f97be22ddd7df5efcce4563657bd49ca2ebf0d.png[/img]
[b]Why?[/b]
The game is now 3 years old and has earned back the Steam Direct fee and little else since 2021.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36190395/fdb1eb89f35bf8a0ade32ad48e5fe7e6a60f9b12.png[/img]
[b]Changes?[/b]
Existing owners of the game should not notice any difference when this occurs, as the only change is the game now being free.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36190395/0e45d78ca6c60ca11c741302d3da7df55a303e53.png[/img]
